A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''mercenary''' was a non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] member of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. She fled from the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] after the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] camp. While scavenging treasures and supplies, she and a group of other [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] were attacked by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].

The female mercenary was killed when Bane used his power over the [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|break]] her neck.
